messages:
Nora: Quick sync — need to lock deprecation comms & launch gates for the catalog transition this sprint. TL;DR: customers on pinned versions need 30d notice + compatibility shim or guaranteed fallback. Thoughts?
Sam: Can we get automation for pin expiry emails? manual is too heavy. I can prototype webhook to send notices based on pin metadata.
Li: We also need to run bench for the fallback variants — latency and regen quality checks. Suggest gating on 95th token latency < 1.2x and QA regressions < 2% using our eval set.
Javier: For enterprise customers, they expect 60d notice and a test window. We should add a two-week migration assistance track.
Carla: +1 to Javier. Also, legal wants a record of customer acknowledgements. Add a flag to our comms that logs accept/decline.
Sam: Agree on webhook. Proposal: allow templates + scheduled cadence. Minimal schema:
```json
{ "customer_id": "C123", "pin_id": "pin-2024-09", "expiry": "2025-04-15" }
```
This triggers: 30d, 14d, 3d reminders.
Nora: Nice. For launch gates, list: 1) Automation sends notices, 2) Fallback passes bench, 3) CS migration plan for top 10 customers, 4) Audit logging for ACKs.
Li: Add automatic eval run on pinned prompts + statistical diff. I'll add alert if delta > 1.5%.
Javier: We need templates for customer-facing comms. Draft below:
```text
Subject: Upcoming model pin expiry — action required
Hi <Name>,
We plan to retire pin <pin-id> on <date>. Options: 1) Accept automatic migration, 2) Stay on legacy (limited support), 3) Request migration assistance.
```
Sam: Can we wire this into console so customers can self-accept? That reduces CS load.
Carla: UX notes — show estimated token cost delta and latency delta in the console acceptance flow.
Nora: Action items: Sam prototype webhook + console button (owner Sam, due Tue), Li bench + alert (owner Li, due Thu), Javier draft comms + list of top customers (owner Javier, due Wed), Carla to design console copy (owner Carla, due Tue). I'll track in the roadmap and add gating QA checklist.
deploy-bot: reminder: sprint planning meeting at 10am tomorrow :calendar_spiral:
Sam: I'll spin up the mock and post a link later today.
Nora: thanks all. if no objections we'll include these gates in the sprint commit.
